落案起訴；通常是拘捕後的法律程序，不等於拘捕本身。

falseSynonyms.zh: 落案起訴不等於拘捕 charge 是正式指控某人犯罪；arrest 是先限制其自由。有人可被捕後不被起訴，也可能先被起訴再處理其他程序。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Police may arrest a suspect before prosecutors decide whether to charge them.

falseSynonyms.zh: 登記入案不等於拘捕 book 通常是被捕後在警署記錄個人資料、指控等程序，不是 arrest 本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A suspect is usually booked after being arrested.

falseSynonyms.zh: 上手銬不等於拘捕 handcuff 只是限制雙手的動作；警方可以拘捕而不一定上手銬，也可在其他安全情況使用手銬。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Handcuffing may accompany an arrest, but it is not the same act.

falseSynonyms.zh: 監禁不等於拘捕 imprison 表示把人關進監獄，通常是司法程序後的結果；arrest 發生得更早。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person may be arrested without ever being imprisoned.

falseSynonyms.zh: 定罪不等於拘捕 convict 表示法院判定有罪；arrest 只是刑事程序早期的拘捕行動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A person can be arrested and later acquitted rather than convicted.

falseSynonyms.zh: 盤問不等於拘捕 interrogate 是正式深入問話；警方可在拘捕後盤問，也可能在未拘捕的情況下問話。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Interrogation and arrest are different procedures.
